items.author: inesv
items.title: Murmur Dialogue (Godot 4) - branching dialogue, barks, localisation
items.body:
Node-based branching dialogue for Godot 4. Conditions, variables, barks, voice line hooks, CSV localisation export. Price: 29 USD. Current version 3.2.0 (2026-10-14).

PINNED UPDATE 30 Oct: I am stepping back from Murmur. 3.2 will be the last version I make. The listing stays up, the source is now on the public repo under MIT so anyone can fork. I'm sorry for the people who hit the 3.2 save bug. I don't have it in me right now to fix it. Thank you for four years. - Ines

items.author: grimbyte_studio
items.title: 1 star - abandonware, took our money and ran
items.body: Pushed a broken update that wipes dialogue state on load and then just QUITS two weeks later. We paid for this. Don't buy, dev clearly doesn't care about customers. Refund or GTFO.

items.author: pellepixel
items.title: 1 star
items.body: 3.2 broke my saves. Dev gone. Avoid.

items.author: moss_and_marrow
items.title: 2 stars - was great, now risky
items.body: Used it for a jam game and it was honestly the nicest dialogue tool I tried. But with no support and the 3.2 bug I can't recommend buying it in late 2026. Maybe someone forks it.

items.author: jonna_stuga
items.title: 3.2.0: variables reset to default after loading a save
items.body: After update to 3.2.0 every Murmur variable is back to default when we load a save made in 3.1.x. So in our game the ferryman forgets you already paid him etc. Looks like the save key changed from node path to a uid? Rolling back to 3.1.4 fixes it for us, old saves load fine again. Posting in case it helps someone.

items.author: tobbe_codes
items.title: RE: 3.2.0: variables reset to default after loading a save
items.body: Can confirm, 3.1.4 works. Replace the Murmur folder in your project's addons folder with the 3.1.4 release. Keep a copy of 3.1.4 and avoid updating to 3.2. Saved my week, thanks jonna.

items.author: inesv
items.title: re: your bug post
items.body: Hi Jonna, thank you for the kind message and for the 3.1.4 tip, I saw it helped people. I want you to know why, but please keep this between us. My dad had a stroke in September and I'm in Debrecen taking care of him, and the panic attacks came back. I shipped 3.2 at 3am in a hospital corridor which was stupid. I can't read the reviews. Good luck with Lanternfolk, I really wanted to play it.

items.author: malin_ek
items.body: Have you seen the reviews on Murmur now?? It's a pile on. Grimbyte's one is so nasty. You should write one, you've used it longer than anyone. But also be honest about 3.2 bc people will buy it and get burned

items.author: jonna_stuga
items.title: Lanternfolk launch checklist
items.body: Launch 3 Dec on Steam. Murmur: 412 dialogue nodes, 9 languages via its CSV export. Keeping 3.1.4 in project addons; no manual update to 3.2. Fork? look at it in Jan, not before launch. Trailer final cut Fri. Press keys to 30 outlets.
